subject: a small stone shrine deep inside a dark overgrown hollow, the whole frame packed with wet ferns and hanging moss and the trunks and roots of old cedars pressing in on every side, and crowded everywhere across its ledges and along its roof and among the roots in the near foreground, dozens of small crude figures hacked out of rough pitted grey granite, coarse and primitive and lichen-stained, each with a simple scratched face and funny crooked little drawings gouged into the stone, bundles of feathers and small pale animal bones and a few tiny animal skulls tied to the shrine with twine, paper strips knotted to the branches overhead, red spider lilies pushing up between the figures, cold violet and cyan light filtering down through the canopy from behind
